name: Harp
author: Versilian Studios (samples); DAW build script
attribution: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition (Sam Gossner / Versilian Studios), CC0 1.0
desc: Concert harp, plucked mf, natural ringing decay (no sustain). Range C1-G7. Arpeggios, glissandi-style runs, sparkling ostinatos, gentle chords. | Playable MIDI 24-103 (C1-G7), 1 velocity layer. Params: pedal=1 lets notes ring until the next chord (sustain pedal, re-pedals on each new note); human 0-1 adds timing/level life; velcurve <1.6 = soft notes louder; bright = velocity opens tone; keytrack = high notes brighter.
